_meta.notes: Lightning coeffs hand-set from anti-patterns.md priors. Mach-E K_us tuned via grid sweep from 0.002 -> 0.0015 (CTE 101 -> 99). Hyundai coeffs fitted via fit-model on 60 train / 20 dev segments, yaw_plus_cte objective. Per-segment delta0 detector uses V0 yaw-rate prediction (allowed contract column) instead of a_lat_meas_mps2 (NOT in allowlist).

TESLA_MODEL_3.note: Tesla sim truth column IS the V0 KS output (psi_dot_rads). V0 passthrough is optimal.

module-2.v3_agent-03._notes: V4 model: yr = v * (delta - delta_off - c3 * delta^3) / (L + K_us * v^2) + tau * d(delta)/dt + bias. Fitted per-platform with L-BFGS-B on yaw RMSE objective (route-grouped 80/20 train-dev split). Tesla deliberately set to all-zeros for V0 passthrough since the platform's truth column IS the V0 KS output (no independent measurement).
